name: smwsprites-stunnable-boo
title: Stunnable Boo
description:
This is a Stunnable Boo (also known as boospEEEN), based on imamelia's Boo disassembly. This variant of the boo can be stunned, and when in the stunned state, will spin out of control for a duration of time before reverting back to a regular boo. You can customize how long the Boo is stunned for, it's X and Y speed when stunned, and other various behaviours (such as being stunned by the P-timers).

See the .asm file for usage notes and customization options.

Credit goes to Jammerjab for the spinning Boo idea and most of the spinning frame graphics (I added 1 extra frame to the rip).
